title: The 2020 scan detects the Queen's Chamber shaft

tellings.quote: You can actually see the horizontal shaft coming out of the Queen's Chamber is detected, I would say, fairly accurately.

plain: A radar scan of the Great Pyramid at Giza made in 2020 picked up the horizontal shaft that runs out of the Queen's Chamber, one of the known rooms inside the pyramid. That is the reading of a researcher named Jeffrey Drum, who points to a study titled "Synthetic aperture radar Doppler tomography detects undiscovered high-resolution internal structures of the Great Pyramid of Giza" and says the shaft shows up "fairly accurately." If he is right, the method can see real features inside the stone, and that gives weight to the other hidden structures the same scan is said to reveal.
